paths.configuration_paths: relative to current working directory, not the configuration file

creation.exclude_hidden_true: omit files and directory subtrees whose names start with a dot
creation.password_file_set: read password from the existing file and encrypt file content
creation.overwrite_false: fail if output exists; preserve the existing archive
creation.overwrite_true: replace existing output; no undo or previous-version retention
creation.configuration_changes: apply on next create; do not modify existing archives
creation.snapshot_id: automatically allocated random UUID; no configuration field
creation.block_index: sealed after writing; maps file records to compressed frames

verification.encrypted_archive: requires the same password used for creation, not necessarily the same password file path
checks: compare plaintext SHA-256 and uncompressed length
does_not_check: equality with the current source directory
whether every intended file was selected
verification.success: exit code 0 and the message Archive verified
verification.failure: nonzero exit code; do not claim the archive is verified

restoration.password: encrypted archives require the creation password; PackTrail cannot recover a lost password
restoration.target: must be an existing empty directory; no overwrite option
restoration.file_content: read block index, decrypt when needed, decompress when needed
